name: Disk Usage
description: See which folders and files take up space with a treemap, and move what you no longer need to the Trash
help: Choose a folder (or a whole disk) and press Scan. Folders are read in parallel; external drives and network mounts inside the folder are not entered.
The treemap shows every item as a rectangle sized by how much space it uses. Files are colored by type; click a folder to open it, and use the path above or the up button to go back.
Contents lists the current folder sorted by size, Largest shows the biggest files anywhere inside it, and Types shows how much space images, videos, documents and other kinds of files use.
Tick items and choose Move to Trash to free space; they can be restored from the Trash. Symbolic links are not followed and hard links are counted once.
Folders that cannot be read (for example because of permissions) are skipped and counted at the bottom.
